cards.text: WEEKENDER — OLD MONEY / FOUR-COLOR WOMEN

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: The exact selected old-money ad, with one change: its opening grid shows four different women carrying the Weekender. Cognac top-left, Army Green top-right, Dark Chocolate bottom-left, Black bottom-right. Fashion aspiration leads through four distinct outfits and natural settings. Original narration, cream-blouse presenter, caption style, body scenes and 51.3-second edit are preserved.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text:
Everyone wants that old money look until the bag costs more than the trip.

But you don't need a designer label to pull it off. This one gives you that classic, polished feel, whether you're dressing for a weekend away or just heading out for the day.
Original held 2×2 designer-bag grid, continuous cream-blouse presenter and white outlined phrase captions.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Original grid establishes designer style aspiration under the long hook and bridge; this intent is inferred from narration.

Frame zero; hold through full hook and bridge, cut on This is at frame 358. Direct cuts; preserve original presenter, voice and caption timing.
